description: Quote a listed token by chain, token, buy/sell side and raw amountIn. Pool selection and direction are resolved on the server. Optional pool selects a listed pool; optional zeroForOne must agree. Legacy exact pool/zeroForOne calls still work. Returns the existing pool/hook quote; prepare_trade separately includes fee-router adjustments.

amountIn.description: Amount in raw currency units. Buys use the pool quote currency; sells use the token.

chain.description: Chain id, key or name from the QHooks chain registry.

name: quote
title: Quote a token swap
